product_ids.description: Explicit publisher product identifiers. Empty lists or an unknown enclosing product require remediation_product_scope_unresolved and do not establish product-specific remediation evidence.

published_availability.description: Literal publisher availability statement, independent of availability_date. Null requires availability_statement_missing in the enclosing claim issues.

availability_date.description: Explicitly published availability date; never derived from an availability statement. Null requires availability_date_missing in the enclosing claim issues.

scope_binding.description: Explicit reviewed linkage: same source row, the reviewed Arista 0100, 0128, 0201 and 0075 EOS sections, the three pinned HPESBNW04669 AOS-CX product sections, or exact packaged reviewed source bindings. Never establishes a model or software release availability date.

availability.description: Source-led classification separate from literal published_availability. Absent means unknown; never derive an availability date.

conditional_affected.description: True only for an explicit reviewed prerequisite; false only for an explicit unrestricted publisher statement; null or absent is unclassified.

enumeration.description: Optional allowlisted Task3 manifest facts for this source window, never per-period attribution or historical portfolio completeness.

conditional_affected.description: True only for an explicit reviewed prerequisite; false only for an explicit unrestricted publisher statement; null or absent is unclassified.

reported_release_date.description: Literal software release date reported by this publisher release-history source, with platform context retained.

availability_date.description: Original remediation availability date from the advisory. This is advisory context, never a firmware release date, first-fix date or inferred delay.

claim_source.description: Original current claim provenance, distinct from the remediation section provenance retained in source.

reported_release_dates.description: Distinct explicit publisher release-history dates. Never filled from advisory, remediation, bundle, capture or parsing dates.

bundles.description: Publisher notice and member dates remain distinct. Bundle membership is context; it never supplies version identities or fixed CVE counts.

platform_support.description: Literal SKU support minima. No minimum-version or model affectedness join is authorized.

sources.description: Five reviewed source slots, not an expected vendor release archive. Capture and parse times are distinct from publisher dates. Disabled retained inputs are diagnostics only.

release_history_report.title: Literal switching release history and current fix references v1
